config_files.system.json:
{
  "connectors": {
    "all": {
      "pandas": "pandas"
    },
    "sql": {
      "bulk_insert": {
        "postgresql": true,
        "postgis": true,
        "citus": true,
        "timescaledb": true,
        "timescaledb-ha": true,
        "mssql": true
      },
      "instance": {
        "create_metadata_cache_minutes": 14400,
        "stale_temporary_tables_minutes": 1440,
        "temporary_target": {
          "prefix": "_",
          "transaction_id_length": 4,
          "separator": "_"
        },
        "max_partitions_per_sync": 10000
      },
      "chunksize": 100000,
      "poolclass": "sqlalchemy.pool.QueuePool",
      "create_engine": {
        "method": "multi",
        "pool_size": 8,
        "max_overflow": 12,
        "pool_recycle": 3600,
        "connect_args": {}
      }
    },
    "api": {}
  },
  "cli": {
    "max_daemons": 120,
    "refresh_seconds": 0.1,
    "allowed_prefixes": [
      "*"
    ],
    "disallowed_prefixes": [
      "edit",
      "start daemon",
      "start job",
      "stop job",
      "delete job",
      "stop daemon",
      "show daemon",
      "restart daemon",
      "install",
      "upgrade",
      "reload",
      "start worker",
      "show log",
      "python",
      "login",
      "executor",
      "os ",
      "sh ",
      "start api",
      "start webterm",
      "stack",
      "instance",
      "debug",
      "bootstrap",
      "daemon",
      "sql",
      "register plugin",
      "copy "
    ]
  },
  "experimental": {
    "fetch": false,
    "cache": true,
    "space": false,
    "join_fetch": false,
    "inplace_sync": true,
    "uv_pip": true,
    "systemd_healthcheck": false,
    "valkey_session_cache": true,
    "cli_daemon": false
  }
}
